root_cause.text: The GC readahead function `ra_data_block` in f2fs unconditionally submits a read I/O for an encrypted page without checking if it is already up-to-date, causing a kernel BUG when a subsequent read completion on an already up-to-date page triggers the assertion in `folio_end_read`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (folio_test_uptodate(efolio))` to skip the bio submission when the encrypted page is already up-to-date, and the commit description explicitly states: "Page 1 is moved from blkaddr A to blkaddr B by move_data_block, and after being written it is marked as uptodate. Then, Page 1 is moved from blkaddr B to blkaddr C, VM_BUG_ON_FOLIO was triggered in the endio initiated by ra_data_block."
